title: Spawnerfied
body:
# Spawnerfied
**Spawnify Your Game!**
[1.21.10- 26.1]

This resource pack aims to change GUIs
in the game to spawner, allowing you to have the most SPAWNER experience.

## Currently Available Versions:

> **Spawnerfied [0.8 Alpha]**

**Changelog:**

__**Added:**__

- Custom Panorama.
- Custom Button Textures.
- Retextured Most Of The Icons.
- Added Custom Loading Screen.
- Retextured Following GUIs:
1. Chest
2. Shulker Box
3. Grindstone
4. Blast Furnace
5. Creative Menu
6. Dispenser
7. Crafting Table
8. Survival Inventory.

> **Spawnerfied [1.0 Release]**

**Changelog:**

__**Added:**__

- Retextured Following GUIs:
1. Loom
2. Smithing Table
3. Stonecutter
4. Villager Trading GUI
5. Gamemode Switcher GUI
6. Smoker
7. Furnace
8. Crafter
9. Cartography Table
10. Beacon
11. Anvil
12. Nautilus
13. Hopper
14. Enchanting Table
15. Brewing Stand
16. Horse
- Retextured Following HUD Elements:
1. Hotbar
2. Crosshair
3. Armor Bar
4. Locator Bar
5. Hearts [Survival & Hardcore]
- Retextured Tooltips GUI.
- Retextured Bundle GUI.
- Added New Splash Texts.
- Retextured Spyglass Scope.
- Added Custom Recipe Book Texture.

__**Fixed:**__

- Text Visibility Issues On GUIs.
- Fixed Spawnerfied [0.8 Alpha] Creative Inventory Delete Items Slot Texture.
- Fixed Slider Handle Highlighted Texture.

__**Removed:**__

- Custom Loading Screen.
